fields.description: Master switch for send_overdue_reminder / send_overdue_reminders. Turn off to pause reminders (e.g. during a billing freeze) without touching code.
fields.label: Enable Outstanding Reminders

fields.description: Email Account reminders are sent from. Must have Enable Outgoing checked. Leave blank to fall back to Frappe's default outgoing account.
fields.label: Send Reminders From

fields.description: Comma or newline-separated email addresses to CC on every reminder email. Leave blank for none.
fields.label: CC Address(es)

fields.description: How many days ahead of its due date an invoice shows up in the "Upcoming Due Invoices" section of a reminder.
fields.label: Due Soon Window (Days)

fields.description: How often, in days, outstanding reminders are intended to go out. Not yet wired to a scheduled job — this is a placeholder for when send_overdue_reminders is put on a cron schedule.
fields.label: Reminder Frequency (Days)
